(
set -euo pipefail
cmake --build build -j2 --target simdutf
cmake --build build --target help > build/target-help.txt
(cd build && ctest -N -V) > build/ctest-verbose.txt
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
valid = set()
for line in pathlib.Path('build/target-help.txt').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
    m = re.match(r'^\.\.\. (\S+)', line.strip())
    if m:
        valid.add(m.group(1))
targets = set()
for line in pathlib.Path('build/ctest-verbose.txt').read_text(errors='replace').splitlines():
    m = re.match(r'^\s*Test command:\s*(\S+)', line)
    if m:
        name = pathlib.Path(m.group(1)).name
        if name in valid:
            targets.add(name)
targets = sorted(targets)
if not targets:
    sys.exit('no author test executable targets discovered')
print('FORGE_TEST_TARGETS=' + str(len(targets)))
subprocess.run(['cmake', '--build', 'build', '-j2', '--target', *targets], check=True)
PY
test "$(cd build && ctest -N | awk '/^Total Tests: /{print $3}')" = "94"
)
